caption: This drawing depicts the interior of a blacksmith's workshop. The walls are constructed of red bricks, and the floor is made of gray tiles. In the center, there is a circular, brick forge with a gray metal hood above it, venting through the ceiling. Black coal surrounds the forge, with a small red-hot fire burning in the center. A large wooden bellows, with metal pipes attached, is positioned to the left of the forge, connected by a chain and a wooden lever. Various green wagon wheels are leaning against the walls. Several tools and metal objects are scattered on the floor, including tongs, hammers, pliers, horseshoes, a metal bucket, and a green toolbox with various tools inside. On the right, a large anvil sits atop a wooden stump. Behind the anvil, a workbench is attached to the wall, and above it, numerous metal tongs and other hand tools hang from pegs. A vise is mounted on the workbench at the far right. The back wall features a wooden door with diagonal boards and metal hinges. There's a square window with panes in the right wall, letting in some light. A pulley and hook system is mounted overhead on a wooden beam in the left corner. On the left wall is a blue-framed painting or poster with a stylized face, and below it, a large metal cone, possibly for shaping metal, stands on the floor. In the foreground, several star-shaped metal caltrops and a horseshoe mold are present among other tools and materials on the floor.
title: Blacksmith Shop
